dayOfWeek(uint256).notice: 0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday. 1 January 1970 was a Thursday (4).

isDemo().notice: True for the demo calendar, whose weekend is switched by an operator.

secondsUntilOpen().notice: Seconds until the market opens; 0 when it is open.

userdoc.notice: The real calendar: the T-bill market is closed from Saturday 00:00 to Monday 00:00 UTC. It has no owner and no settings, so nobody can change when the weekend happens.
